build_L2Loss: build a python module to compute L2 regression loss on a single epistemic index with optional batch weights
create_XentLoss: create a cross-entropy loss function for classification tasks with a specified number of classes
test_xent_loss_with_custom_labels: test the custom labelling factory to create a cross-entropy loss with a user-defined labeller function
review_AccuracyErrorLoss: review the AccuracyErrorLoss class to evaluate accuracy error of a greedy logit predictor for N classes
summarize_ElboLoss: summarize the ElboLoss class that computes a one-sample MC estimate of the evidence lower bound for variational inference
